question: Which was the first Asian country in the world to enter the Mars orbit in its first attempt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India** became the first Asian country to enter the Mars orbit in its first attempt.
 
• The Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) was launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) on November 5, 2013.
 
• India's successful mission to Mars was achieved on September 24, 2014.
